content: Celery Canvas: chain (sequential, each task depends on prior result), group (independent parallel tasks, order-independent), chord (group + callback fired when all group tasks complete), map (list-apply). Chords require a result backend that supports them (not RPC backend) and the synchronization/join step is described as costly -- a real-world caution about over-relying on fan-in/join primitives in a distributed task queue without transactional guarantees.
